title: Salary-to-Savings Sweep Compliance
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=firefly:txn
| where match(category,"(?i)salary|payroll|income|savings transfer|brokerage|investment")
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(amount>0,amount,0))) as income, sum(eval(if(amount<0 AND match(category,"(?i)savings transfer|brokerage|investment"),abs(amount),0))) as saved by _time
| eval savings_rate=round(100*saved/income,1)
| where income>0 AND savings_rate<20
| sort savings_rate
description: Checks whether the percent of income swept into savings or investments stayed above your chosen floor each month.
value: This turns 'I should save more' into an enforceable personal SLO with a measurable miss condition.
implementation: Tag income and savings-transfer categories clearly in your ledger export; review the monthly savings rate against your target.
visualization: Monthly table of income, saved amount, and savings rate.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether you moved enough of each month's income into savings instead of letting it all get spent.
